flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged (automatic; note: NOT marked setSingletonTrigger unlike most objectives)
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Tracked Fleet is 'blown away' ('annihilated' in card text; engine models it as blown-away state). Playtest card (ExpansionSet.PLAYTESTING, setTestingText). DRIVER (one level up, the actionable flip plan): Tracked Fleet's own REQUIRED trigger annihilates it at start of the owner's turn only if the owner CONTROLS the [EpVII] system it sits on (Card225_034.java:77-90 / twin Card501_061.java); owner may NOT deploy starships there but Supremacy moves there FREE (:67-68); opponent may relocate the fleet up to 3x/game to an [EpVII] system within 3 parsecs (:96-170). So the flip is a control race on a moving host system.

children.req: blown-away state: a card matching filter is 'blown away' (modifiersQuerying.isBlownAway)

flipToFront.prose: The back NEVER flips back to front: Card501_060_BACK.java contains no FlipCardEffect and no flip trigger. Instead the back carries a hard-lose: place Objective out of play if Kylo was just forfeited to Lost Pile from Salt Plateau (where Han, Leia, or Luke present) during a battle you lost.
citations: src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set501/dark/Card501_060_BACK.java:92-127 (required triggers: out-of-play + retrieval cancel only, no flip)

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: blown-away card-state semantics (GameConditions.isBlownAway on Filters.Tracked_Fleet). Not control, occupy, or presence; a one-way state latch achieved by 'annihilating' (blowing away) the owner's own starting Epic Event/target Tracked Fleet.

BACK hard-lose: timing trigger TriggerConditions.justForfeitedToLostPileFromLocation(game, effectResult, Filters.Kylo, Filters.and(Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.wherePresent(self, Filters.or(Filters.Han, Filters.Leia, Filters.Luke)))) AND GameConditions.isDuringBattleLostBy(game, playerId): forfeit-state + battle-outcome semantics.

BACK retrieval lock: control-with semantics: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.Kylo) gates auto-cancel of opponent Force retrieval (required trigger on isAboutToRetrieveForce).

BACK drain bonus: occupies-with semantics: OccupiesWithCondition(self, playerId, Filters.Crait_location, Filters.Kylo) plus locations Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.and(Filters.First_Order_character, Filters.with(self, Filters.First_Order_character)))).
BACK drain lock on opponent: ControlsWithCondition(self, playerId, Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.Kylo) + opponent characterOrPermanentPilotAlone at location.

flip DRIVER = control race: owner controls Tracked Fleet host [EpVII] system at start of own turn; fleet relocatable 3x by opponent; Supremacy free-move is the control tool; do NOT protect Tracked Fleet (its destruction IS the flip)

profileGaps: The actual flip latch remains engine-owned: Tracked Fleet's start-of-owner-turn BlowAwayEffect plus the objective's isTableChanged/canBeFlipped/isBlownAway trigger are not reimplemented by AI.

The profile's first-order-reigns-tracked-fleet-control rule encodes the preferred Supremacy actor route as controlWith, but ObjectiveAnalyzer.isFirstOrderReignsHostControlled and the rule-ID special case intentionally evaluate the source-law driver as ordinary control by any legal source at the physical Tracked Fleet host.

Live modified hyperspeed, alternate legal Episode VII chase ships from hand, Supremacy-only Reserve access, legal cheap First Order crew boarding, and target-aware ship/crew/movement Force reserves are live typed ObjectiveAnalyzer consumers, not dedicated structured fields in JsonProfile. The legacy OBJECTIVE.FIRST_ORDER_REIGNS.RESERVE_7 trace identity is retained for compatibility; objectiveNamedLocations is descriptive and ignored by the Gson runtime loader.

Back-side retrieval cancellation, drain denial, +1 drain modifier, and objective-out-of-play trigger remain engine-owned outcomes; AI consumes the Kylo/Crait payoff and terminalForfeitRules facts to pursue or avoid their board states.
